profileHeader.headline: Communications graduate seeking entry-level content or marketing roles.

dhpView.personalStory: A recent graduate from UTS with a Bachelor of Communications, Jordan is seeking an entry-level role in marketing or content creation. Currently working in hospitality, Jordan is eager to apply developed skills in writing, audience awareness, and communication to a professional setting. Jordan feels a disconnect in the current job market and is looking for opportunities to demonstrate capabilities and build a career.

insightCards.body: Customer-facing experience in hospitality has developed communication, prioritisation, and resilience. University projects show research, planning, and campaign thinking.

insightCards.title: AI Readiness

verifiedCapabilityIndex.summary: VCI is a five-layer verified capability profile. Each layer is independently validated and compared with entry-level sector requirements, including AI Literacy & Fluency.

layers.detail: Jordan can show practical content planning, audience thinking, and clear written output.

layers.label: Workplace collaboration

layers.label: AI Literacy & Fluency
